---
title: "Karte Hain Ali Wale Yeh Iqrar Qalandar"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Afraz"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Karte Hain Ali Wale Yeh Iqrar Qalandar.
Hai Misal-e-Najaf Aapka Darbar Qalandar.
Hasil Hain Tujhe Fatima Zahra Ki Duaein.
Nazaan Hain Tujh Pe Haider-e-Karrar Qalandar.

2
Na Rook Sakein Gaye Yeh Dhamake Humein Hargiz.
Kehte Hain Tere Rozay Ke Zawwar Qalandar.
Takfiriyon Ke Mil Gaye Matti Mein Iraday.
Hain Mehway Dhamal Aap Ke Hubdar Qalandar.

3
Abbas Alamdar Shah-e-Karbala Ke Hain.
Abbas-e-Jari Ke Hain Alamdar Qalandar.
Din Raat Tere Dar Pe Hussain Ibn-e-Ali Ki.
Karte Hain Azadari Azadar Qalandar.

4
Mashad Ka Karbala Ka Maza Pate Hain Woh Jo.
Karte Hain Tere Rozay Ka Deedar Qalandar.
Lein Gaye Qaboliyat Ki Sanad Tere Haram Se.
 Afraz Ke Likhe Howay Ashar Qalandar.

کرتے ہیں علی والے یہ اقرار قلندر

نہ روک سکیں گے یہ دھماکے ہمیں ہرگز

عباس علمدار شاہِ کربلا کے ہیں
عباسِ جری کے ہیں علمدار قلندر
دن رات تیرے در پہ حسین ابنِ علی کی
کرتے ہیں عزاداری عزادار قلندر

۴
مشہد کا کربلا کا مزا پاتے ہیں وہ جو

افراز کے لکھے ہوئے اشعار قلندر
\"\"\"

roman = \"\"\"  1

  2
  Na rook sakein gaye yeh dhamake humein hargiz
  Kehte hain tere rozay ke zawwar Qalandar
  Takfiriyon ke mil gaye matti mein iraday
  Hain mehway dhamal aap ke hubdar Qalandar

  3

  Abbas-e-Jari ke hain alamdar Qalandar
  Din raat tere dar pe Hussain Ibn-e-Ali ki
  Karte hain azadari azadar Qalandar

  4

  Karte hain tere rozay ka deedar Qalandar

  Afraz ke likhe howay ashar Qalandar\"\"\"
assert [line.strip().rstrip(\".\").lower() for line in body.strip().splitlines()] == [line.strip().lower() for line in roman.splitlines()]
for i, (source, reading) in enumerate(zip(urdu.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\"), roman.split(\"\\n\\n\"), strict=True), 1):
    assert source.splitlines()[0] == \"۱۲۳۴\"[i - 1]
    assert reading.splitlines()[0].strip() == str(i)
    assert len(source.splitlines()) == len(reading.splitlines()) == 5
p.write_text(f\"---{metadata}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman}\\n---\\n\\n{urdu}\")

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and verified that the four stanzas align with the preserved wording in `romanLyrics`. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

Read “gaye” as گے in “sakein gaye” and “lein gaye,” and as گئے in “mil gaye.”
